reference.kernel: 64 x RBJ low-pass biquad (TDF-II, float), 200 Hz...12.8 kHz log-spaced, Q 0.7071

gain.baseline: first osp-bench run, #46, 2026-10-25, local VS 2022 Release build, T_ref 10.45 ms
gain.headroom: maxCpuPercent is about 50x the measured 0.0011 %: the block is far below timer noise, so only gross regressions should trip it

smoother_onepole.baseline: #64/#82, 2026-10-25, local VS 2022 Release build (windows-msvc-ci), median of 3 runs, T_ref 10.1-10.4 ms
smoother_onepole.headroom: about 45x the measured 0.011 %: a per-sample one-pole (serial dependency, not vectorisable) on a gain, retargeted every 100 ms

crossfade_delay.baseline: #64/#82, 2026-10-25, local VS 2022 Release build (windows-msvc-ci), median of 3 runs, T_ref 10.1-10.4 ms
crossfade_delay.headroom: about 50x the measured 0.0052 %: 10 ms block-enable crossfade toggled every 100 ms plus a 64-sample latency-padding delay line

eq.baseline: #68, 2026-10-26, local VS 2022 Release build (windows-msvc-ci), median of 5 runs (R 0.156-0.161, 0.162-0.170 %)
eq.headroom: about 3x the measured 0.167 %: graphic9 with all bands at +-6 dB and both cuts on, mono (linked stereo is about 2x)

oversampler_iir_4x.baseline: #63 part 2 (#96, HIIR FPU classes after review), 2026-10-26, local VS 2022 Release build (windows-msvc-ci), T_ref 10.50 ms
oversampler_iir_4x.headroom: about 10x the measured 0.098 %: HIIR FPU up + down at 4x (stages 0-1, 7/6 + 6/5 coefficients), identity processing; one OS region

gate.baseline: #65, 2026-10-25, local VS 2022 Release build (windows-msvc-ci), median of 6 quiet runs, T_ref about 10.3 ms
gate.headroom: about 50x the measured 0.014 %: enabled gate, peak detector + hysteresis/hold state machine + per-sample gain on -12 dBFS noise

input_stage.baseline: #74, 2026-10-26, local VS 2022 Release build, median of 3 runs (r 0.0234-0.0259), T_ref about 16 ms on this machine
input_stage.headroom: about 25x the measured 0.039 %: constant-gain trim (vectorised) + one-pole/one-zero DC blocker per sample

output_stage.baseline: #74, 2026-10-26, local VS 2022 Release build, median of 3 runs (r 0.1266-0.1466), T_ref about 16 ms on this machine
output_stage.headroom: about 19x the measured 0.21 %: stereo, limiter engaged; NaN guard, level, 4x interpolated true-peak detector (3 phases x 12 taps x 2 channels), gain and meters per sample

doubler.baseline: #74, 2026-10-26, local VS 2022 Release build, median of 3 runs (r 0.1638-0.1824), T_ref about 16 ms on this machine
doubler.headroom: about 15x the measured 0.33 %: stereo, two ring writes, two sin() LFOs, two Catmull-Rom reads and the pan/mix per sample; the sin() calls dominate and could move to a phasor if needed

comp.baseline: #66, 2026-10-26, local VS 2022 Release build (windows-msvc-ci), median of 5 runs (R 0.186-0.196, 0.209-0.218 %); earlier runs read R 0.145-0.21
comp.headroom: about 2.9x the measured 0.21 %: defaults (opto) with the tone tilt on; all three mode detectors run every sample

oversampler_fir_8x.baseline: #63 part 3, 2026-10-26, local VS 2022 Release build (windows-msvc-ci), median of 3 runs (0.47-0.49 %), T_ref 10.4-10.5 ms
oversampler_fir_8x.headroom: about 4x the measured 0.48 %: FIR halfband up + down at 8x (HQ), 58/32/34 even-phase taps per stage, identity processing; one HQ region

passthrough_chain.baseline: first osp-bench run, #46, 2026-10-25, local VS 2022 Release build, T_ref 10.45 ms
passthrough_chain.headroom: full chain: the fixed 25 % ceiling (AGENTS.md section 4) applies
